name: CleanGo Innovations Inc.
summary: CleanGo Innovations Inc. develops and markets non-toxic, biodegradable cleaning agents, disinfectants, and industrial-grade solutions. Under its CleanGo GreenGo label, the company supplies a range of products, including formulations for industrial use, fabric and carpet care, and general cleaning purposes, alongside hand sanitizers and sanitary wipes. The enterprise maintains its principal offices in Calgary, Canada.
